note: Belize: nationals of Barbados, Dominica and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines move freely; the listed others enter without a visa for 180 days (the United States), 90 (Russia in 180) or 30 (Chile, listed under both 90 and 30, is taken at 90). Everyone else needs a visa; a 30-day entry on a US, Canadian or Schengen multiple-entry visa, and the repatriation fee asked of Bangladesh, China, India, Pakistan and Sri Lanka, aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
